items.heading: Skoudehkaris
details: Key ingredients: rice, goat or lamb, cardamom, tomato
Brown goat or lamb pieces with onion and cardamom.
Add tomato and simmer until the meat is tender.
Cook rice in the meat's flavorful broth.
Combine the rice and meat and serve hot.

items.heading: Lahoh
details: Key ingredients: flour, yeast, water, ghee, honey
Mix a thin batter of flour, yeast and water and let it ferment.
Pour a ladle of batter onto a hot griddle, spreading it thin.
Cook until bubbles form and the surface sets, without flipping.
Serve warm with ghee and honey.
